text:
olivia: Quick ask 1-line cost-utility for a new 11B-int6 candidate to hand to product/GTN. Need p95, mean, tokens/USD, quality delta.
sanjay: TL;DR: recommend gated hybrid (default int6, int8 fallback). Good win for chat/short completions.
maya: microbench numbers below:
```
model: nova11b-int6
workload: multi-turn chat (avg 120 tok)
mean latency: 195ms
p95 latency: 420ms
cost/token: $0.00085 (inference only)
quality proxy (QA/ROUGE): -1.8% vs 13B-int8 (mostly longform recall)
```
kevin: for short turns (<40 tok) quality delta ~-0.4% and cost ~35% lower. Tail higher on KV coldstarts.
nora: GTN asks: 1) one-line deploy rec, 2) fallback plan, 3) AB test skeleton. My suggested rec: "Default->int6 with 10% canary, deterministic fallback to int8 for low-confidence outputs."
sanjay: Product blurb + 3-row matrix:
"Recommend rolling out nova11b-int6 as default for chat/short completions to cut unit token cost ~35% while keeping near-parity on UX. For long-form recall/high-stakes prompts, route to int8 fallback or higher-fidelity model. Start with a 10% canary; auto-revert if recall drops >3% on control set."
Matrix:
- Default (int6): $0.00085/token, mean 195ms, p95 420ms, quality delta -0.4% (short).
- Fallback (int8): $0.00130/token, mean 240ms, p95 480ms, quality baseline.
- Critical (dedicated 13B): $0.0025/token, mean 360ms, p95 700ms, quality +1.2%.
maya: monitoring hooks: recall_score (1h window, -3%), hallucination_rate (>2%), top1_divergence (>5%). eval-bot will post alerts.
eval-bot: [alert-config] hooks created and linked to #eng-ml & product-runbook.
kevin: next steps: 1) create 10% canary config + deterministic fallback, 2) p95 budget <500ms, 3) 48h AB (N=10k sessions) to measure recall + CSAT proxies. I'll drop canary JSON once ready.
olivia: add GTN hypothesis: "Default int6 reduces unit cost ~35% with <1% negative impact on short-turn satisfaction; recall regressions expected in ~5% long-context traffic and mitigable via fallback."
nora: perfect, will paste into the product handoff doc. :rocket:
